fields.description: What happens when a new Onboarding Request has the same email or contact number as an existing one. "Warn" shows a message but still allows saving; "Block" prevents saving until it's changed; "No Check" disables this check entirely.
fields.label: On Duplicate Onboarding Request

fields.description: Users with this role can still edit an Onboarding Request after it has been processed (moved past Draft). Everyone else is blocked from editing a processed request.
fields.label: Role Allowed to Edit Processed Requests

fields.description: If checked, a Vendor KYC can only be created via the "Start KYC" button on an Onboarding Request — direct creation from the Vendor KYC list is blocked. If unchecked, Vendor KYC can also be created directly by picking an Onboarding Request manually.
fields.label: Require Onboarding Request for KYC

fields.description: What happens when a new Vendor KYC references an Onboarding Request that already has another Vendor KYC. "Stop" prevents saving; "Warn" shows a message but still allows saving; "Ignore" disables this check entirely.
fields.label: On Duplicate KYC for Same Request

fields.description: The onboarding stage at whose submission the actual Supplier record gets created. Every earlier stage still runs normally, but its Vendor field stays blank until this stage creates the Supplier — at which point it's backfilled onto every earlier stage document for the same KYC too.
fields.label: Create Vendor At
fields.options:
Vendor KYC
Vendor Compliance Audit
Vendor Sampling Evaluation
Vendor Reference Check
Vendor Sign Off

fields.description: If checked, filling in any one of Bank, Account No., IFSC/Branch Code, or Account Name on a Vendor KYC requires all four to be filled in.
fields.label: Require Complete Bank Details

fields.description: If checked, filling in any one of Address, City, State, Country, or Postal Code on a Vendor KYC requires all five to be filled in.
fields.label: Require Complete Address Details

fields.description: If checked, each stage can only be started once the mandatory stage(s) before it have been submitted — KYC, then Compliance Audit, then Sampling Evaluation, then Reference Check, then Sign-off, skipping any stage marked not-mandatory below. If unchecked, stages can be created in any order, including in parallel.
fields.label: Enforce Sequential Stages

fields.description: If unchecked, the Compliance Audit stage can be skipped and the vendor can move straight to Sampling.
fields.label: Compliance Audit Mandatory

fields.description: If unchecked, the Sampling & Cost Evaluation stage can be skipped.
fields.label: Sampling Evaluation Mandatory

fields.description: If unchecked, the Reference Check stage can be skipped.
fields.label: Reference Check Mandatory

fields.description: Minimum average rating (out of 5) a Vendor Reference Check must reach to be considered "Passed". A Rating Criteria Template's own Minimum Average Rating, if set, takes priority over this value.
fields.label: Minimum Average Rating (Reference Check)

fields.description: Default order for disabling a vendor during deboarding. Can be overridden per vendor with the "Disable Now" action on Vendor Deboarding Request.
fields.label: Disable Vendor

fields.description: Provider used to request and detect the signed sign-off document. "Manual" needs no external account — an internal user marks it signed by hand.
fields.label: E-Sign Provider

fields.description: Provider used to notify the team when a deboarding checklist task completes. "Manual" just leaves the checklist item for a person to action.
fields.label: Deboarding Notification Provider

fields.description: If unchecked, no new Vendor Satisfaction Surveys are auto-created for active vendors.
fields.label: Auto-Create Satisfaction Surveys

fields.description: How often a new (draft) satisfaction survey is created per active vendor.
fields.label: Survey Cadence
